business_problem: By 2023, Goosehead Insurance’s success had created a critical inflection point driven by three converging forces: regulatory demands, operational scale, and the need for development agility. As a publicly traded leader, maintaining strict data governance for the PII and policy data residing in Salesforce wasn’t optional—it was crucial.
solution_summary: Goosehead Insurance replaced manual processes and disconnected data management with a unified Salesforce Platform strategy, transforming how they protect client data, provision development environments, and prepare for AI innovation. Rather than cobbling together point solutions from multiple vendors, Goosehead chose a comprehensive, platform-native approach to data security, governance, and agent and app development. The Salesforce Platform provides a multilayered strategy that addresses resilience, performance, compliance, and development velocity simultaneously. Building Resilience with Automated Backup and Lightning-Fast Recovery Goosehead replaced their manual data export processes with Backup & Recover, achieving an industry-leading 24-hour recovery point objective (RPO).

solution_components.name: Salesforce Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and governance foundation teams use to secure, govern, and recover regulated client data while speeding environment setup.

business_outcome: Goosehead reported a 97% reduction in row lock errors, 83-92% faster sandbox setup, 112M records archived with retention policies, and a 24-hour recovery point objective.
metrics: 112M high-volume records archived with retention policies
24-hour RPO while reducing recovery time from weeks to hours
architecture_clues: Backup and Recover replaced manual data exports with automated recovery workflows.
Governance and retention policies were applied across 112 million archived records.
Production-like sandbox creation was accelerated to support safer agent and app testing.
